classification.difficultyReason: Apply the taught ratio-sharing procedure: total the fifteen parts, find the value of one part and calculate each person's payment.

content.prompt: The cost of a new office building is to be shared between three people in the ratio $4:5:6$. If the office building costs $\$450\,000$, how much does each person have to pay?

answer.worked:
There are $4+5+6=15$ parts in total.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Value of one part}&=\$450\,000\div15\\\text{Value of one part}&=\$30\,000\\\text{First person's payment}&=4\times\$30\,000\\\text{First person's payment}&=\$120\,000\\\text{Second person's payment}&=5\times\$30\,000\\\text{Second person's payment}&=\$150\,000\\\text{Third person's payment}&=6\times\$30\,000\\\text{Third person's payment}&=\$180\,000\end{align*}$$
